canonical.assignment: assignment.type is target declared slot; flowType is original checked RHS result, store conversion never changes expression result
canonical.compatibilityRoots: expression.compatibilityRoots is optional; if present it is a nonempty dense array of existing {sourceType,targetType} dependency objects in strict UTF8 sourceType/targetType order, unique. Each pair inherits this expression original source path and UTF16 range as classAnchor and joins the exact same-origin directory M12 record. Ordinary relations require every source variant to select a representation-preserving target; as validates operand flowType to result flowType, then contextual relations validate result flowType to expected. Every explicit root must be actually selected and consumed by those relations at this node; as and contextual roots share one sorted unique array. Parentheses inner and outer nodes retain their own original occurrence roots. Pure identity union/presence widening or selection of existing target nonpresence IDs changes no payload or representation and needs no member proof. RuntimeKey is never assignability. The former expression.compatibility field is removed.
canonical.compatibilityWitnesses: required payload.compatibilityWitnesses contains {compatibility: unchanged M12 classCompatibility, dependencies:[{sourceType,targetType}]}. Identity is (compatibility.origin.source,start,end,sourceType,targetType); directory strictly sorted by origin.source UTF8, start numeric, end numeric, sourceType UTF8, targetType UTF8, unique. Dependencies inherit current origin, strictly UTF8 sourceType/targetType pair sorted and unique; active pair cycles use pair back-references. Every expression.compatibilityRoots pair and every entryCompatibilityRoots roots pair is a root with an exact matching directory record; publish only successful selected roots and their reachable closure. Every dependency resolves within the same origin and is a selected nested field/method logical reference relation; every dependency must be consumed and every record reachable from an expression or entry-role root. Identity logical relations require no extra proof. No inferred member names or new hash IDs.
canonical.construction: Nominal construction is required and uses one concrete logical type catalog throughout generic signature and shared M12 classParameter/classSignature/classImplicitForward/classCompatibility records. construction.id is owner type.id plus .ctor. kind is explicit iff constructor is an actual Function, otherwise implicit-base without base or implicit-derived with base; no fake Source functions or parameter declarations. origin is actual constructor declaration for explicit, actual class declaration for implicit. access is actual public/protected/private visibility, or effective inherited visibility. signature uses the actual selected construct signature, whose returnType is owner nominal id and whose parameter types equal construction.parameters[].type. Signature id/sourcePath/declarationRange preserve the official declaration (possibly ancestor constructor); only an official declaration-less default signature uses its actual owner class declaration as provenance. Explicit parameters[].symbol match constructor.parameters[].id and retain actual ParameterDeclaration origins; inheritedFrom is empty. Implicit-derived parameters use construction.id plus .p plus zero-based decimal ordinal, retain the actual inherited ParameterDeclaration origin and inheritedFrom the direct-base construction parameter symbol; these are logical bindings, never invented AST.
canonical.constructorForward: implicitForward is required nullable: nonnull only for implicit-derived. It reuses unchanged M12 classImplicitForward fields target/baseSignature/parameters/origin. target is direct-base construction.id, baseSignature preserves its shared M12 parameters and return (same catalog ids), origin is this actual class declaration. Each ordinal source/target maps the owned implicit logical symbol to the actual direct-base parameter symbol with unchanged M12 classCompatibility from the official checker. Source/target logical type identities agree; actual original parameter declarations and inheritedFrom relations are retained. Managed nominal members and owned Array/ReadSpan length members use their existing source ids; no inferred names, fake members, numeric conversion or extra expression roots. All forwarding parameters and mappings are complete and ordered.
canonical.constructorInitialization: initializationPhase is before-body without a base and after-successful-super with a base. Under the pinned actual native ESNext field options, initializationFields orders each ordinary own property in original declaration order first, then each parameter-property binding assignment in actual constructor parameter order; each own field id appears exactly once and inherited fields never reinitialize. This is evaluation/assignment order, independent of layout/catalog order and implicit native property definitions. Native parameter-property declarations have no initializer expression; their parameter values are assigned by the TypeScript runtime syntax transform in the constructor body, after native ordinary field initialization. Existing parameterBinding joins only real parameter-properties and existing initializer expressions retain original lexical scopes. No initializer expression or value is invented for fields lacking one. superConstruct stays at its actual body occurrence and original ordered arguments; successful direct-base construction precedes native derived own field initialization, then derived parameter-property assignments, before subsequent body evaluation. The Source imposes no unconditional exactly-one-super or first-statement rule: actual official diagnostics and preserved control flow decide source validity. Bare constructor return is preserved; expression returns remain subject to the original official strict diagnostics, with no fabricated owner-valued expression.
canonical.entryCompatibilityRoots: Required payload.entryCompatibilityRoots has exactly one record per real exported function parameter, deduplicating aliases of the same function. Every record is {functionId,parameterBinding,viewType,origin,roots}; join the actual function id and original parameter binding, viewType equals its complete declaredType, and origin is exactly its original ParameterDeclaration classAnchor. Records are strictly UTF8 functionId then parameterBinding sorted and unique. roots is a dense array (possibly empty for identity/native/value-only entry), strictly UTF8 sourceType/targetType sorted and unique, reusing the existing dependency shape. Targets are the reference payload types reachable from this parameter through Array/ReadSpan elements, union members, value/reference fields and actual method parameter/return types. Inheritance contributes its real members, not another base-class payload. A seen TypeId/member-owner closure bounds recursive references. For each target, all reference class candidates in the complete owned catalog are checked by the original official checker assignability AND the existing ordinary representation-preserving logical relation, including all source numeric variants and nominal value identity. Only successful nonidentity candidate-to-target pairs become roots; no extra identity proof or allocation seed is invented. This is an authoritative complete candidate-check role for this entry, not inferred field names, a Published ABI algorithm, Owner declarations, a noalias guarantee or evidence of an actual allocation. Each root joins a same-parameter-origin complete M12 directory record; nested dependencies retain the same origin and cycle rules. Consumers validate every root against the actual parameter type closure and consume every published root as an eligible logical candidate relation, then independently derive fixed published bounds with inherited/call/store flow. No helper source expression is fabricated to obtain entry authority.
canonical.exceptions: Unknown catch binding retains its original declaration and lexical catch block. tryBlock/finallyBlock and catch block retain their original braces and ordered bodies. throw value is evaluated once at its original occurrence. An as expression retains original type/flowType/operator/annotation ranges without asserting an actual value conversion.
canonical.field: field id sha256: + SHA256(tsfg.array-facts.field.v8\0 + JCS({sourcePath,nameRange})); optional parameterBinding joins only original constructor parameter-properties, ordinary fields never acquire it
canonical.files: strict UTF8 path order, exact SHA256 bytes, complete consumed original source closure
canonical.globals: Original let/const Symbol uses unchanged v8 binding ID. Unique globals directory distinguishes existing bindingReference/bindingTarget from local storage. Initializer is published only once in original module initialization order. Source emits no effect or safety summary.
canonical.json: RFC8785 JCS plus exactly one LF; no duplicate/unknown keys
canonical.method: function.ownerType joins concrete nominal catalog; type.methods lists owned function ids; call.receiver evaluated before arguments; overrideTarget joins original actual base method
canonical.module: Original normalized sourcePath is the raw module identifier. module-initialization root target equals this sourcePath, name=$moduleInit. It is not a Source function.
canonical.nominal: nominal: plus SHA256 hex of tsfg.array-facts.nominal.v8\0 + JCS(shared nominalKey)
canonical.ownedCompilerOptions: Exact request config remains strict:true,noEmit:true,allowJs:false; target/useDefineForClassFields are not caller options in this candidate. The original newOwnedProgram fixes NoLib:true,NoEmit:true,Strict:true,Target:ScriptTargetESNext with UseDefineForClassFields unspecified, whose official computed value is true and GetEmitStandardClassFields is true. The producer verifies these actual effective field options. Native ESNext field semantics, not a downlevel classfields transformer branch, govern construction ordering. A change to the fixed owned options requires coordinated contract/projection/consumer revalidation; payload retains the original request config unchanged.
canonical.request: sha256: + SHA256(tsfg.program-facts.request.v2\0 + exact canonical request bytes including LF); request contains exact schemaHash
canonical.roots: Required original roots/requiredRoots tuples are strict kind,sourcePath,name order, unique; required roots must occur among roots. Non-initializer target joins the actual exported FunctionDeclaration; ranges retain original definition. No function/body is pruned.
canonical.scalar: logical pinned scalar declaration name; no arbitrary number alias reinterpretation
canonical.string: primitive checker string; M24 lossless codeUnits int32 0..65535, no Unicode normalization, references retain String value identity
canonical.superConstruct: superConstruct is only an actual super(...) CallExpression inside its explicit constructor function, with callee the actual directBase nominal id and calleeRange the original super token. expression type/flowType are official void; signature is the actual selected direct-base construct signature returning the Base nominal instance. Arguments retain original left-to-right order and actual contextual parameter types/witness roots. No receiver or allocationSite is present: this operates on the current construction receiver and allocates no second object. The callee joins its construction metadata and explicit real Function or implicit forwarding facts.
canonical.this: thisReference type is constructor/method ownerType or class-field initializer owner catalog; no invented parameter
canonical.typeAlias: Original TypeAlias Symbol with binding id tsfg.array-facts.binding.v1\0 + JCS({sourcePath,nameRange}); alias omitted from structural function type identity
canonical.types: strict UTF8 id order; every type reference resolves
canonical.union: flattened unique constituents in strict UTF8 id order; >=2; union<comma-joined ids>; checker-proven members, flow independently projected

commonProgramRules.aliases: Imports resolve actual module and original target declarations. Local alias binding/name range are present only for actual import declarations, re-export has null localBinding/nameRange. Namespace target is the resolved module path. No textual same-name join.
commonProgramRules.bindings: global kind=global; catch kind=catch and declaredType=unknown. Common bindings retain their original v8 identity and original declaration/name/annotation ranges.
commonProgramRules.exceptionGrammar: try requires a tryBlock and at least catchClause or finallyBlock; these fields are permitted only on try. Unknown is an original logical type, not an actual alternative set.
commonProgramRules.functionTypeIdentity: sha256(tsfg.program.function-type.v2 + NUL + JCS({parameters,returnType})); alias declarations retain original Symbol/name/source ranges separately.
commonProgramRules.functionValues: Original named functionId and structural function type; indirectCall evaluates the complete expression callee once before original arguments. Source publishes no targets/effects/environment instances or permission.
commonProgramRules.legacy: The external v8 command and descriptor are unchanged; new common metadata is never added to an old v8 package.
commonProgramRules.lexical: Original function-body named declarations and separate complete bodies; lexical parent/declaration scope and binding owner are original identities. Captures describe direct initialized scalar-local occurrences, excluding nested bodies.
commonProgramRules.nonCredit: No allocation/GC/runtime/device/VM/SourceEXE execution or kernel permit is produced.
commonProgramRules.permissions: Every common field and function retains access=public/private/protected from its original declaration modifiers; ordinary top-level functions are public. Constructor access remains in construction.access. No default-public inference substitutes for source permission facts.
commonProgramRules.privateVersion: Request/package version2 and identity domains v2; old private v1 is rejected, never reheadered.
commonProgramRules.whole: One official Program and checker lease produces one common typed directory, module globals, ordered initialization, validated roots and complete function bodies. No partial-facts merge, body pruning, Source AST transport or Source-computed safety authority.

kindRules: Base required fields plus kind-specific listed fields required; only declared object fields permitted. Optional scalar token decimal/bits permitted only numericLiteral; type markerOrigin/base optional for nominal types.
